There are four curves marked ①②③④, among which the dashed line marked ④ is located at the lower right, overall continuously declining from about 30%, and by 2005 it drops to less than 10%, making it the curve with the most obvious decline. Then reason: The question stem states that this figure represents the changes in the “proportions of output value of the three major industries and the proportion of urban population in Jiangsu Province.” With the development of industrialization and urbanization in Jiangsu, the proportion of the primary industry in total output value usually continues to decline; whereas the proportion of urban population and the related proportions of the secondary and tertiary industries generally would not show such an obvious long-term decline. Therefore, the curve marked ④ corresponds to the proportion of output value of the primary industry.

Therefore, the curve marked ④ corresponds to the proportion of output value of the primary industry.
